title: I built a free home for 644 tiny browser games made with AI, and every one is playable in one click 🎮
author: shaymagen
selftext:
Hey everyone! 👋

Over the last few weeks I've been falling down a rabbit hole of games people made with AI tools like Cursor, Claude and Bolt. Some are polished little gems, some are gloriously weird, and a few made me laugh out loud at 2am. The problem was that they were scattered across jam pages, [itch.io](http://itch.io) and random tweets, so they were really hard to find.

So I made [**Vibe1Up**](https://vibe1up.com/), a free place to browse and play them all in your browser. There's nothing to download and no accounts, just click and play.

A few things I'm proud of:

* **644 games** you can sort by genre, engine (Three.js, Phaser, Godot and more) or the AI tool that built them
* **Every creator is credited**, and every play goes straight to their page
* **Starter recipes**, which are our best guess at the prompt behind a game, so you can try making your own
* Press `/` anywhere to search

If you made one of these games, I'd love to hear the real story behind it. And if you'd rather your game wasn't listed, there's a one-click takedown page, no hard feelings at all.
